strings.name: Mike Cannon-Brookes
strings.summary: Mike Cannon-Brookes co-founded Atlassian with Scott Farquhar, developing a team-software business including Jira and Confluence. After Farquhar stepped down as co-CEO in 2024, he continued as sole CEO. He also participates in energy investment and shareholder advocacy through Grok Ventures.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Co-CEO and sole CEO, acquisition agreement and completion, and planned infrastructure and actual electricity delivery are distinguished. Birth retained to year only.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Atlassian, advancing collaboration software and developer tools, and participated in clean-energy technology investment.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: UNSW Bachelor of Science; university alumni records list the class of 2002.
strings.facts.f2.label: Co-founding
strings.facts.f2.value: Co-founded Atlassian with university classmate Scott Farquhar.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Team collaboration software
strings.highlights.h1.text: With his co-founder and teams, developed project-tracking and knowledge-collaboration products; Trello joined by acquisition, not as his sole creation.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Investment in the energy transition
strings.highlights.h2.text: Participated in SunCable through Grok and opposed AGL’s demerger. Investment and advocacy do not establish completed infrastructure or achieved emissions goals.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Publishes first-quarter FY2027 shareholder letter
strings.timeline.t1.text: As CEO, discusses cloud operations and AI products including Rovo; the announcement falls in calendar 2026.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Co-CEO era ends
strings.timeline.t2.text: Farquhar ends his co-CEO tenure and remains a director; Cannon-Brookes continues to lead the company.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Grok completes SunCable asset acquisition
strings.timeline.t3.text: The deal includes operating-subsidiary shares and continues development planning for Australia-Asia Power Link.
strings.timeline.t4.title: AGL withdraws demerger plan
strings.timeline.t4.text: He and other shareholders oppose the proposal; the board withdraws it after judging the required 75% support unlikely. This is not a completed AGL takeover.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Company announces Trello acquisition agreement
strings.timeline.t5.text: Atlassian signs a definitive agreement to acquire collaboration service Trello, expanding its team-software portfolio.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Atlassian lists on Nasdaq
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joins Farquhar at the opening bell as the company begins public trading under TEAM.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Receives UNSW Alumni Award
strings.timeline.t7.text: With Farquhar, receives an alumni award for contributions to Australia’s technology industry.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founds Atlassian
strings.timeline.t8.text: Starts with Farquhar in technical support, then shifts to selling their issue-tracking software Jira.
